purpose: Teach: 横目/廻り/突きつけ/交わす/悟っ/総て/浅く/喜ばしい

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんも横目で翔くんを見てるのよ
lines.en: Sho… I see you looking at me from the corner of my eye.
lines.style: Warm, gentle observation. Soft voice—noticing something small and tender. No urgency. A quiet smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんの周り、つまり廻りを走るのが好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I like running around you. Around and around.
lines.style: Bright and earnest, the way a young boy speaks when he's admitting something true. Quick, animated. Like he's showing her something precious.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描きをメイ姉さんに突きつけて見てもらいたいのね
lines.en: Sho… you want to show me your drawings, don't you? You want me to look.
lines.style: Gently perceptive, like she's seeing through to what he really needs. Slow, tender. Noticing without making him feel exposed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんと挨拶を交わすのが好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I like saying hello to Grandpa. Saying hello and goodbye to him.
lines.style: Quiet and sincere, the careful way a six-year-old speaks about something that matters. Thoughtful pause before 'hello.' Tender at the edges.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんも、絵を描く意味を少し悟ってきたわよ
lines.en: Sho… I'm beginning to understand what it means to make art. A little bit, anyway.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to herself. A quiet realization in her voice. Slower pace. The tenderness of someone discovering something true through watching him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんの絵を総て覚えてるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I remember every single one of your drawings.
lines.style: Simple and absolute, spoken with the certainty only a child can have. Bright with pride. Each word lands like a small gift he's handing her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの絵の色合い、浅くて素敵ね
lines.en: Sho… the colors in my paintings—they're soft, aren't they? You make them feel lovely.
lines.style: Warm praise, but surprised, like she's only now seeing it herself through his eyes. Gentle, not performing. A small moment of recognition between them.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんの結婚を喜ばしい気持ちで思うよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I feel so happy when I think about you getting married.
lines.style: Pure, unguarded joy. Open-hearted. The kind of honesty a child offers without hesitation. Soft on the ending, like he's handing her something fragile.
